terms.title: Tithi
terms.short_description: Lunar day measured by the angular distance between the Moon and the Sun.

terms.title: Paksha
terms.short_description: The bright or dark half of a lunar month.

terms.title: Masa
terms.short_description: A lunar month in the Vaishnava calendar.

terms.title: Nakshatra
terms.short_description: One of the 27 lunar mansions used in Jyotish.

terms.title: Amrita-yoga
terms.short_description: A favorable muhurta window used for journeys and new beginnings.

terms.title: Mahendra-yoga
terms.short_description: A favorable muhurta window printed in the Panjika.

terms.title: Vakra-yoga
terms.short_description: An unfavorable or cautious time window in the yoga table.

terms.title: Shunya-yoga
terms.short_description: A void or unfavorable time window in the yoga table.
